_meta.purpose: Per-arch microbench baseline. Codec PRs gate against these numbers (>5% throughput regression blocks merge). Update by re-running the bench.

bitpacking_constant_4M._note: Per-CTA metadata parse + __syncthreads caps throughput below the type_dispatcher CONSTANT broadcast; vectorised int4 stores keep the kernel from being scalar-store bound.

bitpacking_for_int64_w8_4M._note: Striped scalar __stwt; vectorised stores would scatter the warp across 4 cache lines and lose coalescing.

constant_32MiB._note: Write-bandwidth bound near the GDDR6 fill ceiling.

uncompressed_multi_1024x32KiB_raw_memcpy._note: Reference only — dispatcher bypassed, per-segment cudaMemcpyAsync. Demonstrates why the batched kernel exists.

tunables._note: Per-CTA work bound for the chunked memcpy kernel. Tuned on Turing; re-measure on Ampere/Hopper if those become primary.
